_comment: GOLDEN v2 CANDIDATE — 305-station (303 in-network) GPS-only, 3 h, DOY-129.
Successor to golden0729: same science posture as _agu305_gps (deg-15 single-layer
SH, lane_carry OFF at scale, adm_screen + PD-safe fold + D5 v3 + W6 self-contained
OSB, all-frequency / single-channel, 30 s), PLUS the full Aug-04 LASER
instrumentation tier and the emission-observability candidate. Measured settled
cost on this posture: ~26.7 s/epoch lane-off; census+MDB riders measured at
~1-2 % of epoch on the AGU305 scale gate.
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY. This config arms fingerprinted knobs (emit_clock_disc joins
the inherited set) — never resume it onto a pre-golden snapshot; seed and every
leg must carry the same arm set (cb_excursion_reinit rule generalizes).
WHAT IS DELIBERATELY ARMED BEYOND THE INHERITED POSTURE:
- prefit tier (trace_prefit_census / trace_topology / rhs_attrib_on_trip):
promoted Aug-1, restated here because the inherited base is the Jul-28 set.
- prior_residual_census, all five families + corroborate (auto-arms
gap_instrument, instrumentation-only, byte-identity proven).
- prior_residual_global_sigma0: on this carry_invariant posture the DATA side
reads NO_DATA by construction (postFitRaim is carry_warm-gated and Pass-1
walks pl_amb, which do_amb_carry empties — the twice-corroborated Aug-4
finding). The prior-side sums and per-family variance factors are the live
product here; the full tension ratio needs the leveling companion arm or the
sanctioned decouple fix. The in-band flag says so per epoch — expected.
- redundancy_census stride 10 — the ONLY r_i source on this posture, and the
sweep host for mdb / block_baarda / congruence.
- carry_vce monitor (M2): the per-family honesty/cliff instrument the census
and sigma0_global triangulate against; pl inert here (carry_invariant), cb
live. carry_vce_APPLY stays OFF: unvalidated (its S7 contract unclaimed),
INERT-by-loader-WARN on this posture, and apply-armed lineages REFUSE warm
resume entirely in v1.
- mdb: census feed live, RAIM feed 0-by-construction (counter says so).
- block_baarda + corroborate: THIS RUN IS ITS FIRST FIELD GATE (unit-gated so
far) — OFF byte-identity was proven at unit scale; read n_blocks, the size
histogram BEFORE any ladder, and the smearing fraction per its spec S8.
- datum_graph_census + congruence_screen: landed-this-week cards. GPS-only is
the graph census's CONTROL regime (expect k=1, zero tier-2 predictions,
printed as 'ran, saw nothing'). If either counter block is ABSENT from the
run-end report, that card is not in the build you ran — do not read absence
as quiet (unknown JSON keys are silently ignored; invariant #4).
- emit_clock_disc: FIRST-VALIDATION arm (candidate from the AGU amendments).
Emission-metadata only — per-constellation datum bumps instead of global; the
13 silent post-convergence clock jumps of the 12 h record become consumer-
visible disc records. Solve untouched; E-line field-8 serializes for replay.
IMPROVEMENT ARMS (comparability with FT63/AGU waived by directive, Aug-4:
'turn on everything we think will improve; if not, investigate after'):
- cb_kaula_prior @ sigma 3 m: lifts weak/orphan CB directions — the CODE-
dominated zero-PB-weight class is in the 305-sta record; the K2 margin
check reports the actual lift at load. The known open question (KP's sigma
pull on OSB columns toward 0) is graded BY this run on total_IF, per the
investigate-after model. sigma 3 is the value that held margin on the gg
validation where the sigma-10 default ran thin.
- emit_pb_filter_jump_k: 4.0 — the code default; the lineage-inherited 8.0
was the retired v1 hand tuning.
- sticky_pivot (RTA-1): keep the incumbent clock pivot while it is valid —
fewer handovers, less re-reference churn. Not fingerprinted; idempotent if
an ancestor already arms it.
- PROMOTED 2026-08-08 (user sign-off; SESSION_overnight_2026-08-07.md F16):
serialize_sbasis_contract (piece-1 validated: replay emitter stops
mis-thresholding, -12.7% consumer RMS; header-only, solve-byte-identical),
emit_epoch_status_record + h_sigma0_prefit_census (live census-fed H sigma0,
hsig=pc on the S contract; record-stream 0-diff proven, field-proven on the
EXT and INTERNAL 12h arms). NOTE: products gain the S token + 1 H line per
epoch vs pre-promotion arms — whole-file md5 pairing across this edit
boundary breaks by design; record streams stay comparable.
KEPT OFF — measured-harmful or wrong-regime is not 'might improve':
- lane stack (85 % of runtime at 305 for 0 % fix), emit_pb_filter_gate_v2
(null-to-negative), clock-rate C1 and network.clock_model (net-harmful /
data-incest defect), slip-aware election (+15.7 % total_IF), clock s2z and
broadcast-anchored (consumer-absorbable; pin+guards posture stands),
mw_wl.bridge_sample_debias (net-harmful at 305: 12.5 % wrong-integer).
- sbasis_complete: Galileo channel-family recipe — GPS-only is immune, and
the per-epoch eigensolve is an UNMEASURED cost at 305-sta shared dimension.
PA stays armed as the backstop; if gate withholds appear, that is the
investigate-after, and SBC is the first knob to try.
- phase_leveling: buys nothing under carry_invariant (pl_amb is empty either
way); the dead post-fit tier needs the decouple card, not this knob.
- adaptive_iono_q: requires the T5v2 GM iono model and its record is split
(era-2 reactive half FALSIFIED, prediction half confirmed) — own A/B.
- phase_datum_prioritized: fingerprinted AND possibly a datum-MODE switch
against the armed eq34 chain datum (compose-or-supersede unresolved) —
own A/B, never a golden guess.
GRADING CONTRACT (from the 1 h arm's own caveats): >=2 h before quoting
total_IF (the LEVEL channel converges ~2 h) or the lane-off retention question;
gates on datum-invariant quantities only; census/block science gates need the
converged warm window, the cold half certifies wiring + cost only. Release
build, renamed exe, half-epoch back-off on any start_offset_hours, seamless
lineage for event studies. Run-end MUST show every armed instrument's counters
live: prires families (pl/zwd will read 0 rows WITH the named WARN on this
posture — that is the correct printed outcome, not a defect), mdb rows binned,
bb n_blocks, dg components, cg stations swept.
